hap_score.methodology_note: Computed from the Variables table on this page, not from the NZA data below. Six weighted components (Multifamily Access 30pts, Approval Discretion 10pts, Minimum Lot Size 20pts, ADU Approval Pathway 15pts, Parking Mandate 10pts, Demolition Delay 15pts) are each scored against a fixed, published rubric from a specific cited fact above. Higher = more restrictive. 1 of 6 components had no independently-confirmed input for this town and were excluded; the composite is renormalized over the remaining 5.

v2.formula: V2 = sum(district score x acres) / sum(acres) over included districts
v2.method: Each district is scored with the same six-component rubric using only its own rules. The score uses four components that every town can document (multifamily access, approval discretion, minimum lot size, ADU pathway); a district is included only if all four are confirmed. Parking and demolition delay are shown as context but not scored, so towns share one scale. The town V2 score is the land-area-weighted mean of included district scores; acreage is from data/land_area/trumbull.json. Components with no confirmed input are excluded per district.
